vector_add.title: Vector Addition (c = a + b)
vector_add.description: Step-by-step dialect lowering from high-level tensor math down to machine assembly.

stages.title: 1. Source Code Intent
stages.description: Expresses element-wise vector addition at the source code level.
stages.code:
# Python Baseline
for i in range(N):
    c[i] = a[i] + b[i]

# Mojo SIMD Kernel
vectorize[compute_simd, simd_width](N)

stages.title: 2. High-Level Tensor Representation
stages.description: Abstract multidimensional operations with affine index maps and iteration space decorators.
key_concepts: iterator_types = ["parallel"] flags that all elements are independent

stages.title: 3. Loop Generation (Lowering Pass)
stages.description: Pass: --convert-linalg-to-loops. Replaces tensor abstract operations with explicit loop bounds.
key_concepts: Generates scalar memory loads and stores

stages.title: 4. SIMD Vectorization Pass
stages.description: Pass: --affine-vectorize="virtual-vector-size=8". Packs 8 floats into a single 256-bit AVX register.
key_concepts: Maps directly to CPU SIMD execution units

stages.title: 5. LLVM IR Lowering
stages.description: Pass: --convert-vector-to-llvm --convert-func-to-llvm. Transforms into pointer offsets and LLVM vector instructions.
stages.code:
llvm.func @vec_add_llvm(%ptr_a: !llvm.ptr, %ptr_b: !llvm.ptr, %ptr_c: !llvm.ptr) {
  %vec_a = llvm.load %ptr_a : !llvm.ptr -> vector<8xf32>
  %vec_b = llvm.load %ptr_b : !llvm.ptr -> vector<8xf32>
  %sum = llvm.fadd %vec_a, %vec_b : vector<8xf32>
  llvm.store %sum, %ptr_c : vector<8xf32>, !llvm.ptr
  llvm.return
}

stages.title: 6. Machine Code Execution
stages.description: Final binary emitted by LLVM backend targeting CPU execution units.
stages.code:
.LBB0_1:
    vmovups (%rsi,%rax,4), %ymm0      # Load 8 floats from Array A
    vaddps  (%rdx,%rax,4), %ymm0, %ymm0 # SIMD Add 8 floats with Array B
    vmovups %ymm0, (%rdi,%rax,4)      # Store 8 floats to Array C
    addq    $8, %rax                  # Increment index by 8
    cmpq    $1024, %rax               # Loop condition check
    jl      .LBB0_1
key_concepts: vmovups and vaddps: 256-bit AVX SIMD instructions
8 additions completed in single clock cycle latency

matmul.title: Matrix Multiplication (GEMM)
matmul.description: Transforming O(N^3) memory-choked loops into cache-blocked, vectorized FMA micro-kernels.

stages.title: 1. Named linalg.matmul Op
stages.description: High-level declarative matrix multiplication on tensor types.
key_concepts: Compiler recognizes standard GEMM pattern for targeted optimization

stages.title: 2. Cache-Aware Loop Tiling
stages.description: Pass: --linalg-tile="tile-sizes=64,64,64". Slices 512x512 matrices into 64x64 blocks that fit into CPU L1/L2 cache.

stages.title: 3. Vector FMA & Register Packing
stages.description: Pass: --convert-linalg-to-vector. Emits vector.contract / vector.fma across 8x8 register accumulator tiles.
key_concepts: Keeps working tiles in 16-32 vector registers (ymm / zmm)

operator_fusion.title: Operator Fusion (Linear + Activation)
operator_fusion.description: Fusing compute passes to eliminate DRAM memory traffic.

stages.title: 1. Unfused Pipeline (High Memory Traffic)
stages.description: Two separate kernels connected by an intermediate DRAM buffer.
key_concepts: 2 full memory writes + 1 full memory read
Slowed down by memory bus bandwidth

stages.title: 2. Fused Kernel (Pass: --linalg-fuse-elementwise-ops)
stages.description: Combines GEMM accumulation and ReLU directly inside CPU registers before writing to output.
